data.body: **[P2] Establish reuse of the provider that experienced export failure.** With concurrency two, the healthy invocation can run on the other worker; environment replacement can also provide a fresh provider. This test then passes even if export failure leaves the original provider unusable. Retain both calls' evidence and require matching environment, process, PID, and provider identities before accepting recovery. Use bounded placement attempts if needed, and add a negative control showing that recovery on a different worker is rejected.
